semantics: Half-open intervals, matching BaseFeeMarket.bucketOf: bucket 0 covers (-inf, bounds_wei[0]); bucket i covers [bounds_wei[i-1], bounds_wei[i]); the last bucket covers [bounds_wei[n-1], +inf). A value equal to a bound belongs to the bucket that starts at that bound, so bounds_wei[i] is never in bucket i. All values and bounds are integers in wei.
